root_cause: web/src/tasks/TaskPopup.js onProjectChange() ran form.model.assigneeIds = [] unconditionally on any project change — wiping even assignees who are still members of the newly-selected project.
diff_summary: Keep assignees who are members of the newly-selected project (filter by project.members); clear only when no project is selected.
design_decisions: Sibling defect: CommentPopup.js has the same unconditional assignee-wipe on project change — recommend a separate ticket.

why_chain: The list crashes reading task.due.getTime() at web/src/tasks/TaskList.tsx:88
task.due is a string, not a Date, at web/src/tasks/useTasks.ts:41
The API client returns raw JSON and the mapper skips date fields at web/src/api/mapTask.ts:17
root_cause_trace.trigger_state: a task whose due field is an ISO string after a refetch
root_cause_trace.signal_proposal: Assert the mapped task shape in development builds so a raw string date fails at the mapper, not three components later.
